messages:
support-jess: Heads-up, EuropaHealth reported a big drop in throughput on their Dedicated cluster in eu-west-1 starting ~17:40 UTC. Their requests are queuing and timing out. attaching customer logs below :frowning:
support-jess: `request_id=eu-req-9f3a status=queued duration_ms=12000 retries=1` x many
marisol: @ben @tanya can you take a look? customer says this started after yesterday's runtime kernel rollout to their pool.
ben: looking. initial check: control plane shows normal capacity, but node-level GPU utilization is low. weird.
ben: pulling recent deploys... deploy-bot: `deploy/runtime-kernel-v2.14 -> eu-west-1 (2026-03-14T16:30Z)`
marisol: that matches their timeline.
tanya: can we get a sample request id from customer to trace KV cache and batch behavior? ask them for a request id with start/end timestamps.
support-jess: gave `eu-req-9f3a`, also `eu-req-9f7b`. They saw TPS drop from 120->30 and latency p50 jumped 40ms->300ms.
jonathan: sharing a quick check I ran on the nodes: `nvidia-smi` shows GPU mem ok but processes are mostly in spin/wait. logs show repeated small batches (batch_size=1) after rollout.
jonathan: suspect continuous batching fallback or a change in batching heuristics in v2.14.
ben: good catch. config diff between v2.13 and v2.14 shows `continuous_batching.enabled: true` -> `continuous_batching.enabled: auto` and `batching_window_ms: 5` -> `1`
marisol: that would reduce batching opportunity for short-tail traffic and increase per-request overhead. aligns with low GPU utilization and high queueing.
tanya: quick mitigation options: 1) roll runtime back to v2.13 for eu-west pool, 2) force `continuous_batching.enabled: true` and bump window to 8ms via runtime override, 3) route EuropaHealth to a different variant temporarily.
ben: I'd prefer override + metrics watch, faster than rollback. can we push a runtime override for that customer pool now?
marisol: @ops-bot please apply runtime-override {pool: "eu-west-1-europahealth", continuous_batching.enabled: true, batching_window_ms: 8} and notify if rollout succeeds.
ops-bot: scheduled runtime override job 39012. applying to 3 nodes in pool.
ops-bot: runtime override applied to node-01 node-02 node-03. rolling restart triggered.
jonathan: after override, I'm already seeing batched sizes increase to 8-16 in trace. p50 back to ~50ms. GPU util up.
support-jess: Customer confirmed throughput returning to expected levels. they saw timeouts clear around 17:58 UTC :tada:
marisol: OK — create a follow-up RFC to make the default batching window conservative for dedicated pools until we finish perf testing of auto mode.
ben: opened PERF-612 in backlog with details and linked the runtime config diff and traces.
tanya: also add a postmortem note for rollout gating: require perf smoke on a subset of dedicated pools, and a rollback playbook.
marisol: agreed. assigning owners: @ben for rollout gating checklist, @jonathan for kernel perf regression analysis, @tanya for playbook. support-jess please keep customer in the loop.
support-jess: will do. closing the thread unless anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
